slides.sub: GTA 6 has its own outlaw couple. Here's how to get BOTH legendary weapons and their car.

slides.head: GO TO LUMMOX COUNTY
slides.body: The first hideout is the Outlaw's Cabin in Lummox County. Set your waypoint on it.

slides.head: FIND THE OUTLAW'S CABIN
slides.body: Old wooden cabin with a plaque on the wall for two officers: Daniel Corman & Chris Deponte. That's how you know you're right.

slides.head: TAKE THE BASEMENT DOOR
slides.body: Don't use the front. Go down through the basement door, then climb the ladder up into the cabin.

slides.head: SEARCH THE FIREPLACE
slides.body: Martha is the Bonnie of Leonida. Her MARTHA'S 1922 PISTOL is hidden in the fireplace. Grab it.

slides.head: HEAD JUST WEST
slides.body: The second hideout is a short drive west of the first cabin. Look for another old cabin with a garage.

slides.head: GARAGE SIDE DOOR
slides.body: You can't get into this cabin. Enter the garage through the small side door instead.

slides.head: OPEN THE TRUNK
slides.body: Here lie the remains of Lyle, the Clyde of Leonida. In the trunk of his old car: LYLE'S H&L .38 REVOLVER.

slides.head: TAKE THE GETAWAY CAR
slides.body: The old car is drivable. It takes a moment to start. Bonus: read the old scrapbook in the garage.

slides.sub: Save this before you head to Lummox County and tell us which gun you're keeping.
